page.layout: One page of text. Two coin woodcuts (medallions with portraits and legends) at the top, not text. Below them, one full-width column of running text. A decorative ornament at the foot, not text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ROBOAM filius Salomonis ex Naama Pharaonis filia, mortuo patre regnavit super filios Israël qui habitabant in civitatibus Juda, anno mundi 2971.ante Christum natum 991. nam decem tribus ad Jeroboam defecerant.Hic Roboam spreto senum consilio, juvenum consilium amplexatus est, superbissimè respondens populo qui tributorum imminutionem postulabat:quamobrem defciuerunt ab eo decem tribus. ipse autem 80000. virorum congregavit ex tribu Juda & Ben-jamin, ut sub jugum ejus qui filius & hæres Salomonis erat,mitterent has decem tribus quæ ad Jeroboam defecerant: sed ut ne pugnaret prohibuit Dominus, dicens à se factū esse istud, quemadmodum per Ahiam Prophetam prædixerat. Vide 3. Reg. 11. 12.13.14.cap.& 2.Paralipomen.10.11.12.cap. Josephlib. Antiquit. 8.cap.7. & 8.regnavit annos 17, cui successit filius, nomine Abia, sive Abiam.

SESACH rex Ægypti, ascendit in Jerusalem, & tulit thesauros domus Domini,& thesauros regios & universa diripuit, anno quinto regni Roboam. habebat Sesac in exercitu 1200. currus, equitum 60000. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Coin legends are engraved in the medallions and are not running text. Left medallion: "ROBOM" along the left edge and "R. IVDA" along the right edge. Right medallion: "SESACH R." along the left edge and "AE" at the upper right [?]. Some words in the first paragraph are hard to read at this scan resolution, notably "Josephlib." and the digits "2971" and "80000"; the spacing around the numbers may differ from the print. "defecerant.Hic" lacks a printed space, which is kept as printed. The Latin spelling was changed only for u/v and i/j as the rules require; "Ægypti", "defciuerunt", "factū" and "Abiam" are unchanged.
